notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
Hello, 
This is just a update to tell you about the hotfixes that were applied to galaxy bricks. 

Fixed Issues with steam achievements not unlocking.
(Update) To unlock the campaign achievements replay level 10 in each campaign, and win. This should unlock it for you as soon as you are sent back to the main menu screen.  
Fixed in game leaderboard to show updated score.
(Update) Fixed leaderboards not showing up in steam. 
Added in new controls to control shooting with left mouse click, and holding/releasing the ball with right mouse click.

notes.title: Galaxy Bricks Released!
notes.content: Hello! Welcome to the galaxy bricks store page! I am happy to have you all here. Galaxy Bricks has launched, and I hope you enjoy it. I will be checking any reviews and comments about the game. I want to make sure everything is working as intended.
